'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 European floods]]
**[[2024 Central European floods]]
***The death toll from the ongoing [[flood]]s in [[Central Europe|Central]] and [[Eastern Europe]] increases to eight, including six people in [[Romania]], one in [[Poland]], and a [[firefighting|firefighter]] in [[Austria]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/15/death-toll-rises-as-storm-boris-lashes-central-eastern-europe (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/floods-southwest-poland-kill-one-force-evacuations-2024-09-15/ (Reuters)]

**The death toll from [[Typhoon Yagi]] in [[Myanmar]] increases to 74 people, with 89 others still missing and nearly 240,000 people displaced. [https://apnews.com/article/myanmar-typhoon-yagi-floods-dead-missing-f41b7e73b7ed72bd58e1221e7f620456 (AP)]
*[[English Channel migrant crossings]]
**At least eight [[illegal immigration to the United Kingdom|illegal migrants]] are killed and ten others are hospitalized after a boat [[capsize]]s off the French coast while attempting to cross the [[English Channel]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/15/eight-people-die-while-attempting-to-cross-english-channel-to-the-uk (Al Jazeera)]

**[[Georgia (country)|Georgian]] [[Business oligarch|oligarch]] and [[Georgian Dream]] founder [[Bidzina Ivanishvili]] proposes a national apology to [[South Ossetia]] after blaming former [[President of Georgia|President]] [[Mikheil Saakashvili]] for starting the [[Russo-Georgian War]] at the will of [[Western world|Western powers]]. *[[2024 Nigeria floods]]

***Over 280 [[prison escape|prisoners escape]] from a prison in [[Maiduguri]], [[Borno State]], [[Nigeria]], due to damage to prison walls caused by heavy floods. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/nearly-300-prisoners-escape-nigerian-prison-after-floods-2024-09-15/ (Reuters)]

**At least 20 people are killed in clashes between [[Illegal mining|illegal miners]] near the [[Porgera Gold Mine]] in [[Porgera]], [[Papua New Guinea]]. [https://apnews.com/article/papua-new-guinea-violence-porgera-e98e911db17f48169abf449083f472d8 (AP)]

[https://apnews.com/article/trump-shooting-gunshots-florida-f62f8378d3a8ce7b2e99d6a8fb40aba9 (AP)]
